decision_ledger.rationale: Keeps the existing risk-based research portfolio without inventing historical leverage; makes valuation and cash-flow conversion auditable rather than silently inheriting unrelated paper-trading code.

recommendation.cad_conversion: Extend the frozen entry route table and independently selected latest sealed H1 midpoint close strictly before each cash-flow/valuation timestamp; no wall-clock cutoff, no future/live/entry-bar quote or substitution.
recommendation.cash_accounting: Quote P&L accrues on price differences, translated to CAD at realization/mark time; do not translate entry and exit notionals independently. Initial CAD risk denominator is frozen at entry.
recommendation.decimal_arithmetic: Decimal precision 38, ROUND_HALF_EVEN; only prices outward to instrument tick and units downward; store money/rates to 10 decimal places, keep unrounded internal sums and round reports only.
recommendation.equity_nonpositive: Record insolvent/unresolved evaluation, stop new allocations; no fabricated percentage return across nonpositive equity and no automatic identity change.
recommendation.valuation_grid: Each New York calendar date at 17:00; at a sealed H1 open use bid_open for long and ask_open for short. During a registered closure use the latest completed sealed side-close at or before valuation time, explicitly labelled closure valuation, never an invented tradable bar. Missing an expected member fails closed.

decision_ledger.source: Specification §§12.2,15,16: CAD and downward venue rounding are governed; historical venue step, margin and post-entry accounting details are not.
decision_ledger.topic: Theoretical accounting, margin, unit granularity and point-in-time valuation

decision_ledger.rationale: Completes timing conventions without changing entry geometry or adding an ungoverned profitability-sensitive model.

recommendation.commission_time: Charge round-turn scenario commission once at terminal exit, converting quote fee strictly point-in-time at that timestamp.
recommendation.conflict_rule: Distinct physical setups, including opposite directions on one instrument, remain independent requests and consume gross buckets. Duplicate physical event/book is an integrity error, not a second position.
recommendation.financing_boundaries: Rollover at 17:00 New York on Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri with 1 day and Wednesday with 3; include entry_time < rollover_time <= exit_time. Use latest sealed completed midpoint strictly before rollover for p and each conversion leg. No holiday calendar inferred; disclose holiday uncertainty.
recommendation.semantics: No additional slippage model, not a claim that historical slippage was zero; retain adverse gap and stop-first rules. Commission unknown/excluded and financing unavailable/excluded in primary.
recommendation.stop_target_structure_time_tie: Stop/gap first, target next, daily structure next, time last. At a common boundary previous-H1 touches are resolved first; entry allocations precede scheduled exits exactly as specification §5, so scheduled-exit risk is not prematurely freed.

decision_ledger.source: Specification §§14–16 freezes adverse gaps, stop-first and spread-only primary costs; it does not specify an extra slippage series or commission conversion instant.

decision_ledger.rationale: Makes reproducibility and descriptive use explicit while retaining the governed bootstrap; no realized metric or synthetic trade return is calculated here.

recommendation.block_rounding: Nearest integer, ties upward, for max(5,round(1.5*N^(1/3))); stationary bootstrap starts uniform, wraps circularly and restarts with probability 1/L.
recommendation.confidence_interval: Two-sided percentile interval at 0.025 and 0.975 using linear interpolation h=(B-1)*q; primary positive gate uses lower endpoint > 0.
recommendation.design_sensitivity: Analytical normal-design sensitivity only: hypothetical sigma_R in [0.5,1,2], not estimated from returns. Eligible event/week cluster geometry is not present in the accepted aggregate; do not treat confirmed-week Kish as eligible independence or claim achieved power.
recommendation.replicate_seed: SHA256(UTF8(policy_sha256+'|'+replicate_index_as_5_digits)); deterministic SHA256 counter stream SHA256(seed_bytes+counter_uint64_big_endian), use rejection sampling for bounded integers. Replicate indices 00000..09999.
recommendation.sample_sufficiency: Metrics undefined (null with reason) for insufficient samples or zero denominators; never infinity or substituted zero.
recommendation.week_definition: ISO weeks on America/New_York dates, Monday start, preserve all cross-pair members and attribution within sampled week.

decision_ledger.source: Specification §§18,21 fixes methods and 10,000 replicates, but confidence level, quantiles, seed serialization and Sharpe/Sortino conventions are pending.

decision_ledger.rationale: Conservative proposed adequacy floors, not a claim of sufficient power. The accepted combined book has 90 eligible events; 90 independent observations may still be inadequate for a 0.20R practical effect.

recommendation.insufficient_evidence: INCONCLUSIVE_NOT_PROMOTABLE; do not lower thresholds after observing returns or combine dependent family evaluations.
recommendation.paired_scope: For each paired comparison with a genuine pairing; unpaired comparison uses separate bootstrap and independently meets resolved count. M1 paired count applies only to a separately authorized refinement, not primary H1 availability.
recommendation.scope: Each book/partition being promoted, never pool books or development with holdout. Validation sufficiency is evaluated on concatenated chronological annual OOS folds with each fold disclosed.
recommendation.shared_factor_cluster_definition: Connected components of eligible events linked if same New York entry week and sharing either currency (ignore direction and book); count unique physical events. Recompute as a return-blind future assessment, not by rerunning S1. Current S1 book|instant|direction singleton clusters are not independent macro-factor evidence.

decision_ledger.source: Specification §§18,21 intentionally leaves numeric minima to S2.

decision_ledger.rationale: Defines a demanding, non-cherry-picked rule before any returns; prospective power is unknown and an inconclusive result is acceptable.

recommendation.bootstrap_p_value: For one-sided H0 mean<=0, recenter observations at null, resample clusters with frozen method; p=(1+number(null_stat>=observed_stat))/(B+1). Paired differences retain pair mapping.
recommendation.comparator_rule: For each registered deterministic comparator, lower confidence endpoint of primary-minus-comparator mean observed-spread-adjusted R > 0; matched pairs when available, otherwise separate cluster bootstrap difference. Random timing: primary mean exceeds or equals 95th percentile of all 100 replicate means.
recommendation.cost_grid_robustness: All 15 pre-registered scenario cells fully resolved and mean scenario-adjusted R >= 0; none selected or reweighted.
recommendation.drawdown_role: Report distribution and ratio to 0.0025 planned risk fraction; no arbitrary 10% retirement or inferential drawdown cutoff.
recommendation.family_holm: Three secondary family tests only: order p ascending with stable book tie-break, compare p_(i) <= 0.05/(4-i), i=1..3, stop at first failure; combined primary remains separate.
recommendation.owner_gate: Owner-only non-activating promotion, after all preregistered criteria; no automatic trading or partition unlock.

decision_ledger.source: Specification §21 requires positive uncertainty, practical effect, comparator and cost-grid gates jointly; values pending.
decision_ledger.topic: Practical effect and joint promotion gates

decision_ledger.rationale: Prevents concentrated evidence being presented as broad support; shares are defined so overlapping attribution cannot inflate denominators.

recommendation.denominator: Unique resolved physical trades within each book; weights are initial allocated CAD risk, not profit. For families split each event's weight equally over its attributed families; gross currency-direction shares divide by twice total event risk.
recommendation.failure: NOT_PROMOTABLE; retain all rows and report shares, never discard a subgroup to pass.
recommendation.family_books: Family concentration is definitionally 1 and exempt only from the family-share criterion; all other limits apply.
recommendation.session_categories: London only, New York only, overlap; use entry timestamp in governed timezone union.

decision_ledger.source: Specification §21 requires concentration limits without numeric choices.

decision_ledger.rationale: Preserves the complete H1 model and exact replay, with an explicit proposed ambiguity cap rather than opportunistic refinement.

recommendation.ambiguity_denominator: Resolved primary physical trades; numerator any trade whose terminal classification needed same-H1 stop-first or other within-H1 ordering assumption.
recommendation.m1_disagreement: Report count/fraction and paired changes for every available window; diagnostic only, cannot replace primary results or select primary trades.
recommendation.unavailable_m1: Primary H1 remains reportable. No M1 retrieval, paired execution or mandatory new acquisition is authorized by this candidate; optional refinement remains unavailable pending separate explicit authority.

decision_ledger.source: Specification §§14,18,21 makes H1 complete and M1 paired-only; tolerances pending.
decision_ledger.topic: Ambiguity, replay fidelity and optional M1

future_execution_contract.batch_writes: Future separately authorized executor: one transaction per governed batch, append-only evidence, unique idempotency keys; any failed batch stops, no automatic resume; no writes in this gate
future_execution_contract.benchmark: Representative disposable subset first; extrapolate by workload and record timing; >1800 seconds requires separate authorization
future_execution_contract.preload: Bounded bulk SELECT projections per dataset/instrument/granularity; index ordered sealed timestamps and admitted evidence before replay; forbid per-event ORM queries
future_execution_contract.refusal: No command accepts arbitrary artifact, path/environment override, dataset replacement, --execute, or outcome input
future_execution_contract.replay: Pure deterministic reference then indexed implementation must produce identical transition/evidence hashes on disposable fixtures before activation

lineage.legacy_reference_meaning: Historical strategy manifest compatibility only; never an active dataset default. The accepted relational successor contract and dataset id are mandatory.

definitions.concentration: sum(initial_risk_CAD_i for category)/sum(initial_risk_CAD_i); family fractional allocation and gross currency denominator per S2-06
definitions.coverage: verified_expected_members/expected_sealed_members; unresolved evidence count separately; 0 denominator undefined
definitions.daily_equity: cash_CAD + sum(side_aware_unrealized_quote_pnl*current_point_in_time_CAD_rate); no external deposits, books separate
definitions.daily_return: E_d/E_(d-1)-1; New York 17:00 marks on every calendar day; keep zero-return days; undefined if prior equity<=0
definitions.drawdown: DD_d=1-E_d/max(E_start,E_1,...,E_d); maximum_drawdown=max(DD_d); no observed calculation in S2
definitions.drawdown_planned_risk_units: maximum_drawdown/0.0025; diagnostic distribution, not a retirement rule
definitions.expectancy_R: sum(R_i)/n of resolved allocated unique physical events within one book; blocked and unresolved counted separately, never assigned zero
definitions.kish_effective_clusters: (sum(n_cluster))^2/sum(n_cluster^2); disclose raw count and cluster definition
definitions.paired_difference: D_i=R_primary_i-R_comparator_i for registered matched physical event; mean(D_i); paired cluster resampling
definitions.payoff_ratio: mean(positive_R)/abs(mean(negative_R)); null if either subset empty
definitions.primary_R: primary_cad_pnl/initial_risk_cad; denominator positive and frozen at entry
definitions.primary_cad_pnl: signed_quote_pnl*CAD_per_quote_at_exit; separate commission/financing excluded and labelled unknown/unavailable
definitions.sharpe: sqrt(365.2425)*mean(r_d-0)/sample_sd(r_d-0); sample_sd=sqrt(sum((x-mean(x))^2)/(N-1)); null for N<2 or sd=0
definitions.signed_quote_pnl: s*u*(exit_price-entry_price), s=+1 long or -1 short; side-aware executed prices; no extra spread subtraction
definitions.sortino: sqrt(365.2425)*mean(r_d-0)/sqrt(sum(min(r_d-0,0)^2)/N); null for N<2 or zero downside denominator
definitions.win_rate: count(primary_cad_pnl>0)/n_resolved; zero is breakeven, not win; descriptive only

promotion_language_supersession.scope: All promotion, not-promotable and owner-gate wording inside the verbatim S2-01 through S2-07 recommendation payloads is subordinate to the permanent exploratory boundary.

anti_lookahead.conversion: Each leg independently latest expected sealed H1 completion strictly < decision; exact midpoint close; do not fall back around missing/conflicting required member
anti_lookahead.entry: Only timestamp/bid_open/ask_open from entry H1; no high/low/close/volume exposed to pre-entry decisions
anti_lookahead.future_metadata: Timestamps only for sealed successors and conservative horizon, never future price payload
anti_lookahead.future_resolution: Separate not-yet-authorized adapter may admit exit evidence only after completion and must preserve effective/decision clocks; no resolver provided by this gate
anti_lookahead.partitions: Development 2010–2018; chronological annual validation 2019–2022; untouched 2023–2025 remains locked; source S1 aggregates development only
anti_lookahead.strategy: Only successful sealed complete W/D/H1 with completion <= decision; five-candle pivots available at t+2 completion; source level activation <= sweep interval start; freeze sweep bias

change_control.rule: All seven return-blind defaults are effective. The 0.20R practical-effect target is unconditionally immutable after the geometry became known. This policy and the 2010-2018 cohort are permanently ineligible for strategy promotion regardless of outcomes. Any future confirmatory evaluation requires a separately governed, genuinely untouched cohort. Exploratory return execution remains separately unauthorized; no S0/S1 rewrite.

costs.primary: Observed bid/ask spread counted once; adverse gaps; unknown separate commission excluded; financing unavailable/excluded; not net broker performance
costs.sensitivity: Retain all 15 Cartesian commission/financing cells from manifest, with signed r and d/365, no preferred cell

entry.evidence: Registered, successfully ingested, complete and conflict-free; effective entry open distinguished from later candle admission/resolution.
entry.time: First sealed instrument H1 open >= confirmation completion; no theoretical calendar bar, arbitrary shift or session-delay retry.

holding.count_rule: First ten actual sealed provider D completions strictly > entry, including entry-containing session only if completion > entry
holding.exit: First sealed H1 open >= tenth completion; equality included
holding.purge: Exclude if maximum horizon absent or >= next partition boundary; timestamp metadata only, never an exit-price query

missing.closure: Absence from sealed inventory is legitimate closure; present-in-inventory but missing/conflicting registered row fails closed
missing.evaluation: Fail closed with deterministic evidence IDs/hashes; do not infer result, silently drop, repair or retry S1; unresolved blocks promotability

ordering.allocation: One complete batch per book/timestamp; no pair priority or database insertion order
ordering.target_stop_tie: Stop first in same H1; stop gap worse of stop/adverse open; target no favorable improvement

sizing.bucket_charge: Full planned risk to both long BASE/short QUOTE (long) or short BASE/long QUOTE (short), never net opposing exposures
sizing.rounding: Down to frozen unit step, recompute risk, no redistribution; zero units BLOCKED_CAPACITY

target.inventory: All price-active opposing levels independent of bias, family and setup-consumption
target.long: Smallest active resistance zone_lower strictly above entry ask
target.short: Largest active support zone_upper strictly below entry bid
